description: This file contains utility functions for the vtiger CRM workflow module, including user stack management, user validation, redirection, permission checks, and module support functions.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: A collection of utility functions for managing workflows in vtiger CRM, including user context management, validation, and module checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the user stack if it is empty.

methods.name: validIdentifier
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper identifier (starts with a letter, followed by letters, underscores, or digits).

methods.name: adminUser
methods.description: Pushes the current user onto the user stack and switches the current user to the admin user.

methods.name: loggedInUser
methods.description: Pushes the current user onto the user stack and sets the current user to the previously logged-in user.

methods.name: revertUser
methods.description: Reverts the current user to the previous one in the user stack.

methods.name: toWSModuleName
methods.description: Determines the web service module name based on the EntityData object, with special handling for activities and emails.

methods.name: redirectTo
methods.description: Inserts JavaScript to redirect the browser to a specified URL with a message.

methods.name: checkAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin rights.

methods.name: checkModuleWorkflow
methods.description: Checks if the module supports workflow by querying the database.

methods.name: vtGetModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module names supported for workflows, excluding certain modules.
